summary: Builds a physics file path into an output buffer: obtains an identifier from ShortComputation_0b10(), formats it into a local 256-byte buffer, strips the last dot-suffix, appends the extension string off_5C3F84[0], and copies the composed path into caller buffer a2 bounded to a3-1 bytes. Returns 0 on success and 1 on failure (null a1, or composed length reaching 0x100).

operations.description: Return error code 1 when input a1 is null; no path is built.
Call ShortComputation_0b10() to obtain the identifier used as the path's base name source.
Call sub_587DD0 to write the identifier into local buffer v6 with limit 255.
Force NUL at v6[255] so the local 256-byte buffer is always terminated.
Advance to the end of the string in v6, then scan back to the last '.' (46) and truncate there, removing the existing suffix (extension).
Return error code 1 if the stripped name length plus the length of off_5C3F84[0] reaches 0x100.
Append the extension string at off_5C3F84[0] to the truncated base name in v6.
Call sub_587DD0 to copy the composed path from v6 into output buffer a2 with limit a3-1.
NUL-terminate the output at (a3-1)+a2 after the copy.
Return 0 to signal the path was built successfully.
